cases.prompt: Use banner for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Build a heading-to-image manifest including nested headings, prompt provenance, dimensions, and parent identity.
Match every required heading to one rendered banner; distinguish generated resolution from interpolated resolution.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use banner with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use banner with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Vary camera angle and spatial composition while retaining shared material and lighting tokens.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
